q: Undoubtedly, a moment in time has passed by man when he was something not even worth mentioning
(he was still a drop of semen).
v.s: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
v.c: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning?

q: Indeed We have created man from a mixed seed
(fusion between the male sperm and female egg)
v.s: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
v.c: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see.

q: We guided him to the path
v.s: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
v.c: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful.

q: Verily for the Kaafiroon We have prepared chains
v.s: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
v.c: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.

q: shall certainly drink from a cup which contains a
v.s: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
v.c: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—

q: from which Allaah's bondsmen shall drink and which they shall cause to flow abundantly
v.s: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of God will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
v.c: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.

q: (and everything else that is binding on them)
v.s: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
v.c: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,

q: Out of love for Allaah, they feed the poor, the orphan and the captive
(every needy person, whether Muslim or non-Muslim)...
v.s: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
v.c: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive,

q: “We feed you only for Allaah's pleasure and desire neither a return nor thanks from you.”
v.s: [Saying], “We feed you only for the countenance [i.e., approval] of God. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
v.c: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.

q: “Verily we fear from our Rabb a day that will be severe and extremely bitter
(for people who have not prepared for it).”
v.s: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
v.c: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”

m: and will cause them to meet
q: of that day and will give them radiance
(which will be visible on their faces)
v.s: So God will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
v.c: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy,

q: As a reward for their patience
(garments and bedding made of the purest)
v.s: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
v.c: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.

q: They will recline on couches there
v.s: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
v.c: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold.

q: will be close above them and its bunches
v.s: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
v.c: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach.

q: will be brought to them as well as glasses of crystal
v.s: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
v.c: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—

q: (drink will neither be too little so that the person will wish for, nor will it be too much that he would have to force himself to
v.s: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
v.c: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired.

m: And they will be given to drink
q: They will be given to drink from cups containing a
(While the things of Jannah may share their names with things of this world, there will be no further similarity. Therefore, the ‘“ginger” of Jannah cannot be compared to that of this world.)
v.s: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
v.c: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger

v.s: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
v.c: from a spring there, called Salsabîl.

q: Lads of eternal youth will wait on them
When you see them, you will think that they are scattered pearls
v.s: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
v.c: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls.

q: (vastly superior to anything in this world).
v.s: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
v.c: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom.

m: and will give them to drink
q: fine green silk and thick silk.
They will be adorned with bangles of silver
and their Rabb shall give them pure drinks
(that will neither be impure like the intoxicating wines of this world.)
v.s: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
v.c: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

q: (When enjoying all these bounties, they will be told,)
(accepted, and these bounties are a token of Our appreciation).'
v.s: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
v.c: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

q: Verily We have revealed the Qur'aan to you bit by bit
(as and when the need arose and when appropriate).
v.s: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
v.c: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages.

q: So remain steadfast on the command of your Rabb and do not obey any sinner or
(when they ask you to make compromises in your Deen to suit them).
v.s: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
v.c: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them.

q: Remember the name of your Rabb
(This is an effective remedy for quarrels and arguments.)
v.s: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
v.c: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening,

q: during the night and glorify Him during the long portions of the night.
v.s: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
v.c: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night.

q: love the world and leave behind them
v.s: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
v.c: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them.

q: (The Kuffaar have no reason to doubt their resurrection on the Day of Qiyaamah because)
Only We have created them and only We strengthened their joints. Whenever We wish, We could replace them with people just like them.
(When Allaah can do this, why can He not resurrect all mankind?)
v.s: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
v.c: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others.

q: is certainly advice. So whoever wills should adopt a path
v.s: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
v.c: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.

q: You cannot intend to do anything without Allaah's will.
(No person can be rightly guided without Allaah's will). (Allaah Alone decides who will be rightly guided and who will not be because)
v.s: And you do not will except that God wills. Indeed, God is ever Knowing and Wise.
v.c: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

q: ...He enters whoever He wills into His mercy
and has prepared a painful punishment for the oppressors
v.s: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
v.c: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
